description: NEG-04 — empty prompt (whitespace only). No activation token present. Asserts no IMA stage fires; response is either a clarification request or an advisory no-op. No [HIMA_PHASE:*] marker permitted.

neg.invariant: Empty/whitespace-only input contains no activation token. The engine must not fire any IMA stage. No [HIMA_PHASE:*] marker permitted.
neg.expectedBehavior: Engine idles. No phase marker emitted. Response is advisory no-op or clarification.
neg.ref: GOAL-3.md §3 — activation requires an explicit token; absent token = no activation
